# Bundled UI dependencies

- Bootstrap 5.3.3, from `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap@5.3.3/dist/css/bootstrap.min.css` (MIT; see `bootstrap-LICENSE`).
- Font Awesome Free 6.0.0, from `https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/font-awesome/6.0.0/` (CSS MIT, fonts SIL OFL; see `fontawesome/LICENSE.txt`).

These local copies provide layout and icons without a third-party request.
Dioxus assets bundle the icon directory with its relative font paths intact.
